dialogues.speaker: Ancient Recording
dialogues.text: "...No. I won't doubt your words, Mr. Brahe Reed Miller. The fact that you are here is proof that you were not lying."

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Recording
dialogues.text: "Even if I can't prove it, I choose to believe in the side that gives people hope."

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Recording
dialogues.text: "...Uh, actually, 'Brahe' and 'Reed Miller' are not meant to be used together..."

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Recording
dialogues.text: "Oh, forget it. A beautiful lady like you can call me whatever you like."

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Recording
dialogues.text: "Just as I said earlier, I am here to hunt down Rotwang's dogs. It's an honor to have you assisting me."

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Recording
dialogues.text: "Please don't thank me yet, Mr. Brahe Reed Miller. Even if I've already sent word to him, there is no guarantee he will agree to meet me."

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Recording
dialogues.text: "I still don't understand why he would tell such a lie to..."

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Recording
dialogues.text: "...It's nothing. For some reason, the recorder here was not turned off. It would be troublesome if Morozov noticed. I'm shutting it down now."
